scope: Four checker-confirmed single-defect kinematics.joint_axis Train rows plus one same-asset clean control each; fixed-evidence and active-acquisition conditions; no frozen Test access, SFT training, pricing study, or large-scale collection.

protocols.reference: front_motion_v1: label-independent reference renders at front for rest and every joint's unique non-rest grid detent, each actuating one joint from rest. Explicitly separate from the round2 static_front reference; neither Gold, labels, nor reference program parameters are visible.
protocols.fixed_diagnosis: Front rest, then each joint's grid detents with explicit rest resets, executed before the single paid diagnosis call; dry-run binding to frozen witnesses is required before any call. Fixed steps are never exported as action supervision.
protocols.active: Kimi chooses every action from the visible history with budget equal to the fixed-protocol length; it may stop early.
protocols.audit: Live pixels and actual joint values bound to a frozen manifest (all motion-view witnesses re-rendered and cross-checked with v4 frozen pixels where they exist); evidence counts only when bound and comparable with a visible reference state; fail must name objective defect, joint and parts exactly and cite only exposing steps; uncertain is rejected once comparable exposing evidence was acquired; Gold, annotation, manifest, and Episode identities, row SHA, split, and Test absence are enforced; prompts are scanned for Gold text, private parameters, program source, and program SHA.

configuration.timeout_seconds: 120 for first attempts; 300 (TIO_TEACHER_TIMEOUT) for the four reruns after gateway failure

failure_attribution.PM_102080 (b124e209, both modes): Acquisition succeeded (active took front rest -> joint_0 mid -> limit). The prismatic lid's axis error only changes rim shading in the front orthographic view (max 1.1% changed pixels at front:joint_0:limit; the 1.8% oblique_fr witness has no visible reference). Kimi output uncertain; the audit keeps the rejection uncertain_after_sufficient_evidence under the frozen exposure standard, but the evidence is perceptually marginal, so this is attributed primarily to reference-protocol salience (front-only motion references) rather than to an evidence-blind diagnosis.
failure_attribution.PM_103275 (ec3acb50, both modes): Acquisition succeeded (active explored joint_0, reset, then joint_1 zero/mid). Defect type and joint are correct; parts [link_1, link_2] over-include link_2, the static parent of joint_1. joint->part mapping is not visible in the context (only obtainable through query_runtime hierarchy, which Kimi never used; absent entirely in fixed mode). Strict audit rejects; attributed to localization under limited visible structure information.
failure_attribution.PM_25308 (27d942cd): Fixed mode: called the out-of-plane prismatic drawer motion kinematics.joint_range (foreshortened sweep in front view) - a diagnosis error with joint_1 named only in prose. Active mode (rerun): joint_axis + joint_1 correct, parts [link_2] wrong (gold link_1; link_2 is the parent). Diagnosis/localization error; front-only references make axis-tilt vs range ambiguous.
failure_attribution.PM_25308 clean (d631d433, fixed): Broad-scope pass from front-only evidence; not auditable under the single-reference pass rule, rejected. No false fail on any clean control.

export.action_rule: label-independent: legal teacher action reaching a new state that is frozen-witness-bound and reference-comparable; defect relevance kept as row metadata
export.diagnosis_rule: whole Episode accepted by the independent evidence audit
